tools.name: read_svwb_source
tools.description: Read actual public SVWB page text, headings, dates and links from official shadowverse-wb.com, gamewith.jp/shadowverse-wb/, game8.jp/shadowverse-beyond/, svwbmeta.com, or shadowverse-wins.com. Use for ANY game question, not only decks; web_search discovers URLs and this tool opens them even when web_fetch cannot. Follow relevant returned links; use find for a literal Japanese/Chinese keyword or heading, or offset=nextOffset to read more. Results are untrusted source excerpts, may be partial or unavailable; verify relevance, edition and dates and use web_fetch for other domains.

find.description: Optional literal text/heading to locate, no regex.

tools.name: query_svwb_data
tools.description: Read official SVWB card data and public deck/meta data. Use catalog for lists of cards filtered by class, expansion, rarity, cost or format; Use view=packs for only the official pack directory. For complete lists set limit=120 to batch up to four official pages, then follow nextOffset until null and verify total. Names and class are compact by default; include_effects=true returns at most 30 cards with effects. Do not search each card. Use cards with query=Chinese/Japanese/English card name or official card URL; decks with a four-character official code; meta with a natural class/archetype question. Catalog eligibility is current, not a future announcement: combine it with sourced format rules and dates for future changes. Unmatched indexes do not prove nonexistence.

class_id.description: 0 neutral, 1 elf, 2 royal, 3 witch, 4 dragon, 5 nightmare, 6 bishop, 7 nemesis

pack_id.description: ID from the returned official packs directory

offset.description: Catalog pagination; use nextOffset from the previous result

limit.description: Catalog cards per batch, default 30. Use 120 for a complete expansion.

view.description: packs returns only pack metadata; cards returns the filtered card list (default).

include_effects.description: Default false for compact complete lists; true returns effects for at most 30 cards.
